note: make board-post NOTE=... must contain NO double-quote characters. A double quote inside the note survives the single-quoted shell arg and then breaks the boards own key=value parser, which fails the whole post. Established this session: a NOTE containing the phrase (quote)the containing cell WaterKind class(quote) failed with -- board: expected key=value, got "containing" / make: *** [board-post] Error 2 -- and the identical note with the quotes removed posted fine (c6cfb172). Workaround: rephrase without quote marks; parentheses and colons are safe. Related and already documented: pass PATHS via its own variable, never as a JSON array inside FIELDS.
